title: diagnosis.v1
description: The pipeline-engineer agent's final answer. A diagnosis (kind absent or "diagnosis"): what broke, why, the evidence quoted from files, and the proposed fix with its tests. A requested change (kind "change"): symptom is the request and fix the change; nothing broke, so root_cause and evidence are optional and never invented. A path is repo-relative, or DATA:/STATE: relative to that root; never absolute.

kind.description: diagnosis (the default): something broke. change: the operator asked for a change.

symptom.description: What was observed (a run id and exit code, a missing field), or the change requested.

fix.description: The proposed change and the files it touches; null only when blocked.

tests.description: The test names that prove the fix (each fails without it).

blocked_on.description: null, or who or what the next step waits for.

path.description: repo-relative, or DATA:/STATE: relative to that root: no leading / or ~, no .. segment.

quote.description: The exact text read there, at most 200 characters.

allOf.description: A diagnosis (no kind, or kind diagnosis) names its root cause and quotes at least one piece of evidence.
